# Data-access notes (lead session, September 25, 2026)

Chronological notes of every read outside source/docs that could matter for the no-read boundary.

- 11:00 AM: `snapshot_state.py pre` hashed the saved-record roots it lists (stores under data/ifsm_ui_replication, data/ifvg_study_drafts, data/ifvg_search_jobs, data/ifvg_pipeline_jobs, data/ifvg_preparation_jobs, data/ifvg_visual_review, data/ifvg_profiles.json, data/ifvg_datasets/search/v1, search_test/v1, context_views, replay_chart and two catalogs, data/ifvg_experiments, reports/funded_comparison, reports/funded_payout, research/core, pyproject.toml). Hashing reads those files' bytes. data/databento is not among the roots.
- 10:55–11:05 AM: read the published export folder reports/funded_comparison/funded_comparison_5fa65149843484b1_export_v4 (run_manifest.json, approximated_minutes.csv, trades.csv, settings.json, firm_rules.json, configuration_bindings.json) — published review files, not raw market data.
- 11:06 AM: benchmark check read the verified strategy package's shared/market_bars.parquet through market.load_index_minutes with the study cutoff (the same stored one-minute bars the app reads; rows after the June 10, 2026 cutoff are filtered by the reader after loading the file's selected columns).
- ~11:12 AM: ran `du -sh .` inside the isolated app copy (…/ifvg-dashboard-redesign-20260924/isolated/app), which contains data/databento as a directory junction to the live data/databento. Verified at 11:14 AM with a scratch junction that this Git Bash `du` does NOT follow directory junctions without -L (a folder holding only a junction to 4.8 MB reported 0; with -L it reported 4.8 MB). So the junction was not traversed; du reads directory metadata only, no file contents. Recorded here because AGENTS.md forbids recursive listing of data/databento.
- ~11:41 AM: provenance probe read the saved result, the verified package's data/trades.csv (setup records), shared/market_bars.parquet (through load_index_minutes with the cutoff) and the published export v4 approximated_minutes.csv/run_manifest.json; the pre-task run imported code from a git-archive extraction in the session scratchpad.
- ~11:46 AM: race_evidence.py read the same saved result, package calendar and stored bars.
- 11:56 AM: A8 UI reproduction on the ISOLATED copy's review ledger (…/ifvg-dashboard-redesign-20260924/isolated/app/data/ifvg_visual_review/review_v1.jsonl): backed up (sha256 e861127e…), one seeded review appended through visual_review_store.append_review, one notes-only save through the page, then the backed-up bytes restored (sha256 e861127e… verified).
